13.    ORDINANCE       2’ READING
                        —                Amending the Official Zoning Map of the City of
                                           —




       Cheyenne. changing the zoning classification for land located south of Interstate 80, east
       of Campstool Road, and north of HR Ranch Road from AG Agricultural to BP Business
       Park, (SPONSOR DR. ALDRICH)
                             -




Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2 reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried with Dr.
Rinne and Mr. Segrave voting “YES” and Mr. Layhourn voting “NO.”

Morgan Dennis, Planning & Development Department Planner, provided a staff report. Brad
Emnions, AVI P.C. and owner’s representative provided information related to utilities to the
property and Deborah Lowham, property owner, provided additional information related to the
development of the property. Charles Bloom, Planning & Development Department Director,
provided information related to purchasing land for Greenway expansion. Chairwoman Aldrich
and all committee members commented on the item. Public comments were made by Katheryn
Atkins, Matt Baumann, Lone Wayne Chestnut, Vicki Herren, Maria White and Ward I
Councilman Larry Wolfe.

                                                                      —




Mr. Segrave moved to approve on 2d reading, seconded by Dr. Rinne. Motion carried by

Connor White, Planning & Development Department Senior Planner, provided a staff report.
Megan Kvanichfeld. Trammell Crow Company, provided additional information and was
available for questions. Committee members Laybourn and Segrave commented on the item.
